offering_description.value: Owns and operates a fleet of modern very large gas carriers (VLGCs) that transport liquefied petroleum gas on the seaborne market. Customers are oil majors, energy traders and petrochemical firms who charter the vessels on time charters, spot voyages or pooled arrangements.

primary_services.value: seaborne LPG transportation; ship chartering; vessel management

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas majors, commodity traders, petrochemical and LPG producers and importers

end_markets.value: liquefied petroleum gas; energy; petrochemicals; shipping

revenue_model.value: service fees: time charter hire and spot voyage freight for LPG carriage, including pool revenue

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates VLGC vessels, hauling LPG for energy companies and traders

geography_served.value: global: Global seaborne trade, notably US Gulf Coast exports to Asia and Europe, and Middle East routes

specialization.value: niche specialist: VLGC ownership and operation for LPG transport only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct charters with energy companies and traders, plus brokers and a pool arrangement

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: International shipping rules: IMO emissions and safety conventions, classification societies, flag state and port state controls, sanctions
